content.text:
Cannot connect to Podman. Please verify your connection to the Linux system using `podman system connection list`, or try `podman machine init` and `podman machine start` to manage a new Linux VM
Error: unable to connect to Podman socket: failed to connect: ssh: handshake failed: read tcp 127.0.0.1:61694->127.0.0.1:59571: wsarecv: An existing connection was forcibly closed by the remote host.

observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "===== FINAL EVIDENCE SNAPSHOT ====="
echo "--- process-compose process count ---"
curl -sS http://localhost:8080/processes 2>/dev/null | /workspace/.venv/bin/python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin)['data']; print('total:',len(d),'running:',sum(1 for p in d if p['is_running']))"
echo "--- docker infra ---"
docker ps --format "{{.Names}} {{.Status}}" | grep -vE "init-1|minio-proxy|bootstrap" | sort
echo "--- docling ---"
curl -sS -m 5 http://localhost:5001/health; echo
echo "--- frontend ---"
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "3002/app/: %{http_code}\n" -m 5 http://localhost:3002/app/
echo "--- public entry ---"
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "3000/app/: %{http_code} (302 to keycloak)\n" -m 5 http://localhost:3000/app/
echo "--- tool versions ---"
echo "node=$(node --version)  pnpm=$(pnpm --version)  uv=$(uv --version)  pc=$(process-compose version | grep -m1 Version | awk '{print $2}')"
